title: gridui-01: Scroll/list primitive
summary: ScrollRegion widget (gridui-task-01, PR #177) shipped — vertical-only, wheel + draggable thumb, focus-gated keyboard scroll, ensure_visible/scroll_to_child API, showcase + docs. Follow-ups tracked as separate tasks (sidebar scroll wiring overlaps plugin-03; pick-a-region mode small/optional; PageUp/PageDown + nested hit-testing deferred; horizontal scroll + scrollbar token cut).
